about: Every kernel the source defines (tools/kernels.py) and how it meets each obligation: a pointer to the artifact that meets it (a test file, `file::test`, a budget, a sanitizer row of tools/sanitize_oracle.py), {"exempt": reason}, or {"owed": reason}. Checked by tools/lint/coverage.py, gated as a ratchet: a kernel absent from this file, or a pointer to nothing, fails the commit; owed entries are the backlog, printed with their reasons. Docs: docs/internals/tools/coverage.md

obligations.oracle: a test grading the kernel against a reference per slot (an fp64 oracle, or a bit-exact model of a discrete function)
obligations.sanitizer: a row of tools/sanitize_oracle.py's family table whose cell launches the kernel
obligations.phases: a phase ledger the kernel books and a test or tool that reads it (KERNEL_STANDARDS §22)
obligations.ratified: recorded by the committed manifests ("manifest", checked per arch), or owed until the next milestone ratify (KERNEL_STANDARDS §16)
obligations.overlap: a row of tools/overlap_gate.py timing the kernel on a perf cell against the largest of its floors (KERNEL_STANDARDS §28)
